items.title: Dutch supercar maker Spyker is back from the dead with the C8 Preliator XXV
items.summary: Spyker is one of those car companies with a history far stranger than most. The original Dutch marque was founded by brothers Jacobus and Hendrik-Jan Spijker in 1880 as a coachbuilder, before moving into cars and, eventually, aircraft.
